notes.title: STEAMRUSH Post Launch Hotfix
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone![/b]
We've rolled out a quick hotfix to address some minor issues reported by our community. Thank you all for your valuable feedback! Your input helps us improve the experience for everyone.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed dash direction with no directional input.
[*] Renamed "Heavy Attack" to "Guard Breaker" to match actual use.
[*] Sped up "Guard Breaker" animation, and reduced damage to match actual use.
[*] Added hints to Scrap Knight's phase change explosion solution.
[*] Reworded tutorial texts to match new names and match actual functionalities.
[*] Rebalanced lighting in dark areas.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]
